findings.location: ...their political might handed Hitler the office of prime minister. ...
findings.source_quote: The thousands of new Nazi Party members enabled the Nazi Party to seriously contest many local elections, and in Germany’s Parliament, they were able to control enough votes to sway policy making. In the long run, their political might handed Hitler the office of prime minister.
